column1: # Lexical alias -> disease ontology id, for the DiseaseResolver (Level 2).
# These are NAME synonyms / abbreviations only -- no biological content. Each
# alias must point at an ontology id that is actually present in the ingested
# `diseases` dataset; aliases whose target is not ingested are ignored (and
# reported), never invented. Matching is case-insensitive and whitespace-
# normalized, so only add forms that differ after that normalization.
# Format:  <alias><TAB><ontology_id>       ('#' comments and blank lines ignored)
